runtimeProvenance.note: No build/install was performed during this research; version and mtime alone do not identify the source commit.

priorManualCaseFingerprintChecks.method: Compare each case's full source-file SHA-256 between prior and current manifests; case interpretations remain historical, not post-fix measurements.

semantics.requests: Persisted assistant records, not deduplicated physical requests
semantics.cost: Recorded nominal usage.cost.total, not billed cost; zero-priced failures remain zero observations, not proven free
semantics.context: input+cacheRead+cacheWrite only, not totalTokens; provider normalization must be checked before cross-provider comparison
semantics.acceptance: Explicit parent-final receipts only; group is a transcript proxy, not a task episode
semantics.errors: Current local classifier applied retrospectively; historical implementation versions unproven
semantics.toolChars: Delivered text character counts, not tokens or savings
semantics.historicalCausality: Historical traces do not prove this checkout was running or that current fixes save cost
